entities.title: Every schema is a valid Draft 2020-12 schema
entities.summary: tools/validate.py checks each schema/*.schema.json against the Draft 2020-12 meta-schema, then uses utv-1.0 to check the examples, the specification's embedded examples and the fixtures.
criteria: Each file in schema/ is a valid Draft 2020-12 schema.
The conformance examples, the complete UTV examples embedded in spec/*.md and every UTV value in the fixtures are accepted or rejected as their files say.
